The in-house 293(2) K P63 22 refinement is used because the final article and abstract interpret diffuse scattering as evidence for partial cation ordering and present P63 22 as the structural model. The same deposited CIF also contains a P-31m refinement, and the article reports that Hamilton tests on merged and unmerged intensities give contradictory symmetry preferences; this ambiguity is preserved rather than hidden. Al, Si, and Fe were constrained to the EPMA fractions on each partially occupied cation site. Hydrogen was determined analytically but was not located by X-ray refinement and is therefore absent from atom\_sites. The structural cell volume 83.703(6) A^3 and Z=1 are explicit in the deposited CIF. The executable EOS reference volumes are fitted values for this same conventional cell. This composition is distinct from the existing Mg-rich phase\_d material.

Canonical room-temperature record. The first BM3 row of Table 2 freely fits V0, K0, and K0'; neither of the two ambient-volume-fixed alternatives is stored as another executable record. The BM3 choice is justified by the abstract's reported coefficients, Figure 3's exclusive display of BM3 curves, and Table 3's BM comparison across phase-D studies. Parenthetical errors are retained as generic published uncertainties because the source does not state a confidence convention.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

## Observation datasets

### fe\_bearing\_al\_phase\_d\_criniti\_2023\_table1\_compression

- **Description:** All 26 room-temperature single-crystal compression observations from both runs in Criniti et al. (2023), Table 1. The 21 rows at or below 38 GPa are flagged as the BM3/Vinet selection; five higher-pressure rows document the changed compression regime.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume\_lattice\_parameters
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Criniti; Ishii; Kurnosov; Glazyrin; Husband; Boffa Ballaran
    - **Year:** 2023
    - **Title:** Structure and compressibility of Fe-bearing Al-phase D
    - **Source:** American Mineralogist
    - **Volume:** 108
    - **Locator:** 1764-1772
    - **DOI:** 10.2138/am-2022-8559
- **Source location:** Final article, Table 1
- **Associated EOS records:** fe\_bearing\_al\_phase\_d\_criniti\_2023\_bm3\_1; fe\_bearing\_al\_phase\_d\_criniti\_2023\_vinet\_2
- **Uncertainty:**
    - **Pressure:** Table 1 defines sigma\_P as the semi-difference of ruby pressures measured before and after each diffraction scan.
    - **Lattice and volume:** Parenthetical last-digit values are transcribed as generic published uncertainties because no confidence convention is stated.
- **Notes:** Rows remain in printed run order. No ambient zero-pressure row appears in Table 1. The source fit range is stated as room pressure to 38 GPa; all 17 run-1 rows and the four run-2 rows at 5.84, 9.23, 23.07, and 33.30 GPa reproduce the published coefficients under EosFit-style effective-variance weighting. The five run-2 rows from 40.75 to 52.41 GPa were excluded from the ordinary BM3/Vinet fits and used only in the separate spin-crossover treatment. Raw before/after ruby wavelengths are not published. A data license is not stated in the article.
